acceptanceCriteria: review --base either uses the same affected planning path as `affected --base`, or withholds the embedded section with an explicit unknown and the next command to run; it never reports a selection or a gate-absence claim derived from a truncated inventory.
A gate-absence claim (NO_REPOSITORY_GATE_DECLARED) is emitted only when the governing inventory was read completely.
On a fixture whose inventory exceeds the guidance cap, review matches the standalone affected selection or abstains with a named reason; maintained tests cover both the over-cap and within-cap cases.
The spec that owns review's affected projection is updated with numbered requirements in the same change.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Source: read-only rc.3 accuracy survey 2026-10-06 (origin/main 3dc863bd, installed rc.2 build 360) replaying merged PRs 571, 614, 594, 557, 610 at their merge-base. Harness and outputs: /private/tmp/claude-501/td-survey (local, not retained in the repository). On PR571, the affected section in `corvint review --base` reports `selected: []` with provider EMPTY_SELECTION, marks every changed source UNINDEXED_SOURCE_PATH with 'immutable source inventory incomplete', and claims NO_REPOSITORY_GATE_DECLARED ('no Makefile gate target or AGENTS.md Verify block'), although both exist. A standalone `affected --base` on the same range selected 73 units. Cause: reviewGuidance (cmd/corvint/repository_guidance.go:429-480) runs affected.Build over a GuidanceSnapshot capped at 4096 entries / 8 MiB (internal/genesis/guidance.go:30-36); this repository has about 7265 files, so 2742 inventory entries and 3418 sources are never read. This violates product invariant 2 (missing evidence must produce uncertainty, not invented certainty).

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#640 (rc3 batch 3), merged to main 2026-10-06T23:10:49Z as 0c27e35f48581601fbfaf9613d0216b5f8ca3a46. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0865-review-affected-inventory.md and docs/decisions/0438-rc3-batch-3-requirements-accepted-2026-10-06.md at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0438 records the owner's acceptance of AFP-V0-032. The batch passed the full doc-gate CI list, the focused package tests and every hosted CI check on the merge head. NOT_RUN: make gate, -race, and live fleet qualification where the spec says so.

title: review --base: embedded affected section reports EMPTY_SELECTION and a false NO_REPOSITORY_GATE_DECLARED from the capped guidance snapshot
